unit.why: A short narrative: the Maggid of Kozhnitz visits R. Elimelekh with his daughter, and R. Elimelekh foretells that a great soul will descend to her. That soul is the future rebbe of Mogielnica.
unit.boundary_note: opens the birth narrative of the Mogielnica rebbe, which continues in the next division (ז)

stories.start_quote: ועתה אכתוב בעזה״י מלידת מרן ז"ל
stories.summary_en: The Maggid of Kozhnitz visits R. Elimelekh of Lizhensk with his daughter. R. Elimelekh foretells that a great soul will descend to her, and the author explains that this soul was her son, the rebbe of Mogielnica.
